title: Data Chameleon: A Self-Adaptive Privacy-Enhancement System for Structured Data
summary: Data Chameleon is a self-adaptive synthetic-data generation system that lets users specify per-use-case privacy/utility trade-offs for structured data sharing, combining multiple generator and metric plugins (e.g. Synthcity, Anonymeter). One of its generator plugins wraps the standalone CTGAN package, which the project's own comments identify as coming from the SDV family, to produce synthetic tabular data.
